Name: White Shadow
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
Possessing intelligence beyond other mecite animations, the white shadow resembles the woman who appears in the dreams of those with amniasis. It is a compressed, dense amalgamation of memories taken from the amniatic, and is capable of processing information on a level above regular humans. All white shadows share a joint consciousness, and hold absolute sway over other mecite animations. They are horrific beings that most truly represent Mnemosyne’s instinct to reawaken.

Despite their intelligence and awareness that Mnemosyne does not wish to drain other creatures of their memories this way, the white shadow is a distillation of a buried instinct within Mnemosyne from when she was a Grand Primary. It is concerned only with awakening Mnemosyne, and despite understanding the concepts of compassion and despair in mortals it does not fret over the pain it causes. From its perspective it knows what is best for Mnemosyne, and even if she was awakened it would continue to gather memories on her behalf.

Stat Blocks.title: White Shadow
languages: understands the languages of creatures it has taken memories from, but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Amniatic Miasma
traits.description: When a creature starts its turn within 15 feet of the shadow or moves there for the first time on their turn, they must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure they are afflicted with strong amniasis, and their Wisdom score is immediately reduced by 1d4.

traits.name: Aura of Dreamseeking
traits.description: All mecite animations within 60 feet of the white shadow gain a bonus to their attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks equal to the shadow’s proficiency bonus.

actions.name: Memory Spike
actions.description: Three creatures the shadow can see within 60 feet have their minds wracked with discordance, and must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take 33 (6d10) psychic damage. Any creature that is reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is rendered unconscious and stabilized, but afflicted with strong amniasis.

actions.name: Memetic Spear (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The shadow conjures a massive icy blue spear of psychic energy and hurls it at a creature it can see within 120 feet as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit. Hit: 55 (10d10) psychic damage. The spear then unleashes a shrieking storm of corrupt memories, forcing all creatures within 15 feet of the target to make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw. Each creature that fails is stunned for 1 minute, and can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns and each time they take damage, ending the effect on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Dream Step
bonus_actions.description: The shadow teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

reactions.name: Spell Mirror
reactions.description: When the shadow succeeds on a saving throw against a spell or effect produced by a spell, the shadow can cast that spell immediately at the same level as the triggering spell, requiring no spell slots or components, choosing new targets with a full understanding of its effects. This new spell uses a +9 modifier for spell attacks, and/or a save DC of 17.
